tips.text: Charge Arcanopulse longer for more range, but you move slower while charging, so start it out of enemy reach.
Land Eye of Destruction first, then fire Arcanopulse at the slowed target. The slow makes the beam much easier to land.
Aim Eye of Destruction so the enemy stands in the center. The center hits harder and slows more.
Fire Shocking Orb from long range, because it stuns longer the farther it travels.
After Shocking Orb stuns, follow with Eye of Destruction. The stunned enemy can't step out of the center.
Use basic attacks on enemy champions when Mana Surge is ready, because they restore double mana. Last-hitting minions also brings it back sooner.
Stay away from enemies who can reach you. Xerath is strongest when he pokes from range and is weak once they close in.
Use Rite of the Arcane to finish low-health enemies or to start a fight. Every missile has a delay, so aim at where enemies will be, not where they are.
Cast Rite of the Arcane from a safe spot. You can't move for the first part of the channel, and the enemy can see your range circle.

combos.name: Slow into Arcanopulse
combos.when: Poking in lane when you want a reliable Arcanopulse hit on a target who is walking around.
combos.text: Eye of Destruction slows the target, so the slow Arcanopulse beam is much easier to land. Cast the W first and release the Q as it lands.

tips.text: Hit an enemy with Eye of Destruction first, then fire Arcanopulse; the slowed target is much easier to hit.
Aim Shocking Orb from far away when you can; the longer it travels, the longer the stun lasts.
After Shocking Orb stuns someone, drop Eye of Destruction on them. They can't step out of the center.
Start charging Arcanopulse before the enemy walks into range, but keep moving; charging slows you.
Shocking Orb stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in front of your target will soak it. Line up a clear path.
Auto an enemy champion when Mana Surge is ready; it gives back extra Mana against champions.
Use Rite of the Arcane from a safe spot to finish fleeing enemies or punish a trapped team. Each missile has a delay, so aim ahead of them.
Enemies see Rite of the Arcane's range circle, and you reveal yourself when firing near them. Pick a spot that diving enemies can't reach.
Fire Arcanopulse at enemies walking toward or away from you; side-to-side movement is harder to hit.

combos.name: Slow into Arcanopulse
combos.when: Poking or catching an enemy who is hard to hit with a straight beam.
combos.text: Eye of Destruction slows the target, which makes the long Arcanopulse beam much easier to land.

tips.text: Keep your distance and use Shocking Orb on Ahri when she walks up to Charm you; a long-range orb stuns her longest.
Stand behind minions when Ahri has Charm ready; it stops at the first enemy it hits.
After Shocking Orb stuns Ahri, land Eye of Destruction on her; the center hit slows her heavily and hurts the most.
Poke Ahri with Arcanopulse from long range while she lacks space to reach you. Charge it fully for the extra reach.
Be careful when charging Arcanopulse, since it slows you. Ahri's Charm is easy to land on a slowed Xerath.
Ahri is much weaker while Spirit Rush is on cooldown. Play more aggressively then, and stay back when it is ready.

comboRefs.note: Eye of Destruction's slow helps land Arcanopulse on Ahri when she walks around poking with Orb.

tips.text: Keep Shocking Orb for when Akali dashes in. A stun at long range holds her for a long time.
Poke her with Arcanopulse while she is low on energy. Charge it out of her reach, then release.
Aim Eye of Destruction at her smoke. Area spells still hit her in Twilight Shroud and briefly show where she is.
Do not charge Arcanopulse when she can reach you with Shuriken Flip. You are slowed while charging and cannot move away.
Play safe at level 6 when she has Perfect Execution ready. Stay back from her when your health is low.
Aim Shocking Orb at Anivia's path, not at the wall. Crystallize blocks the orb, so wait for it to melt or hit her from the side.
Do not stand still after Flash Frost lands; Anivia's Frostbite hits much harder on a chilled target.
Do not charge Arcanopulse while Anivia has Flash Frost ready; you are slowed and easy to hit.
Use Eye of Destruction to slow Anivia, then follow with Arcanopulse; fight her while Glacial Storm is down.
Killing Anivia the first time does not finish her; wait for the egg, then hit it. Save Rite of the Arcane for after she is reborn.
Aim Shocking Orb at Aurora when she is lined up with you; the further it travels, the longer the stun. Follow up with Eye of Destruction.
Land Eye of Destruction first, then Arcanopulse; the slow makes the beam much easier to hit.
Keep your distance and poke her; she has to close the gap, and The Weirding only slows briefly.
Hold Shocking Orb for when she hops in with Across the Veil; she can't act while she hops, and you can stun her as she appears.
Her Twofold Hex is a line shot, so step sideways to dodge it, and don't stand still while charging Arcanopulse.

comboRefs.note: Eye of Destruction's slow helps land Arcanopulse on Aurora when she walks around in lane.

tips.text: Aim Shocking Orb at Cassiopeia from long range, because it stuns longer the farther it flies. Her walking in a line makes it easier to hit.
Do not charge Arcanopulse right in front of Cassiopeia; it slows you, so you are easy to hit with her spells.
Do not face Cassiopeia when she casts Petrifying Gaze. Turn away to be slowed instead of stunned.
Once Cassiopeia is poisoned, stay clear of Twin Fang. It hurts a lot and heals her.
Use Eye of Destruction on Cassiopeia as she walks up to cast. It slows her.

comboRefs.note: Eye of Destruction's slow makes Arcanopulse easier to land on Cassiopeia as she walks around lane.

tips.text: Keep Shocking Orb for when Fizz commits. If he is untargetable during Playful, wait for him to land, then stun him.
Poke Fizz from long range with Arcanopulse and Eye of Destruction. He wants to close the gap, so stay back and don't let him reach you.
If Fizz dashes onto you, stun him with Shocking Orb at close range. It stuns for less time up close, so follow up fast.
Fizz can't be hit while he balances on his trident, so don't waste Arcanopulse on him then.
Keep your distance when Fizz throws Chum the Waters. Watch where the lure lands and walk out of the shark's area.

comboRefs.note: Eye of Destruction slows, but Fizz's Playful makes him untargetable, so the slowed Arcanopulse can be dodged.

tips.text: Keep Malzahar away from you. Use Eye of Destruction and Arcanopulse from long range, and don't let him walk up on you.
Hit Malzahar with Shocking Orb when his Void Shift is down. While it is up, his crowd control immunity and damage reduction will waste your spell.
Poke him with a spell to break Void Shift first, then follow up with your big damage.
Stay away from minions that Malefic Visions is on. When they die, it spreads to the nearest enemy, which could be you.
Move out of the way of Call of the Void. If you are silenced, you can't cast anything in the trade that follows.
Don't channel Rite of the Arcane within Malzahar's reach. Nether Grasp suppresses you and stops the whole channel.
Keep your distance from Orianna and poke with Arcanopulse; you are weaker once she reaches you.
Aim Shocking Orb from far away for a longer stun, then follow up with Eye of Destruction on the center.
Use Eye of Destruction first to slow Orianna, then fire Arcanopulse where she walks.
Stay away from the Ball when Orianna is at level 6. Command: Shockwave pulls you in and stuns you.
Orianna only hits where the Ball is, so keep out of its reach and watch where it lands after Command: Attack.

comboRefs.note: Eye of Destruction's slow makes the slowed Arcanopulse beam easier to land on Orianna.

tips.text: Keep Ryze at range with Arcanopulse and Eye of Destruction; he wants to close in and chain his spells, so don't let him walk up for free.
Save Shocking Orb for when Ryze steps in to trade; a long-range orb stuns him and his combo is ruined.
Be careful when Ryze has Flux on you; his Overload and Rune Prison then hit harder and root you.
Land Eye of Destruction on Ryze's path first, then follow with Arcanopulse; the slow makes the beam easier to hit.
Do not charge Arcanopulse right next to Ryze; it slows you while charging and he can use Rune Prison on you.
Keep your distance and use Arcanopulse from long range; Sylas wants to be close to you, so do not let him walk up freely.
Save Shocking Orb for when Sylas dashes at you; it stuns him, and the longer it travels, the longer the stun.
After a stun, drop Eye of Destruction on him so the center hit lands and he is slowed heavily.
Shocking Orb does not stop at the first minion, so fire it through the wave only when Sylas is the first enemy in its path.
Do not use Rite of the Arcane with Sylas nearby, because he can steal it with Hijack and fire it back at you.
Keep your distance from Twisted Fate. Poke him with Arcanopulse and Eye of Destruction, and don't let him walk up to you.
Land Shocking Orb on Twisted Fate when he comes in for a Gold Card. The stun stops him from trading.
Follow a Shocking Orb stun with Eye of Destruction. The target can't move, so the center hit lands.
Think twice before you start Rite of the Arcane once Twisted Fate has Destiny. He can teleport next to you while you channel.
Stay at long range and poke Viktor with Arcanopulse. He has to walk up to you, so charge it and release it as he steps forward.
Stun Viktor with Shocking Orb when he walks up to trade. A long flight means a longer stun, so fire it from far away.
After Shocking Orb lands, drop Eye of Destruction on him. He can't move, so the center hit is guaranteed.
Don't stand still inside Viktor's Gravity Field. Step out before it activates, or you will be slowed and then stunned.
Don't charge Arcanopulse while Viktor is in range of Hextech Ray. You are slowed while charging and can't dodge well.
Use Rite of the Arcane to finish Viktor when he is low or stuck. The delay on each shot is short, so aim at where he is walking.

comboRefs.note: Eye of Destruction's slow helps land Arcanopulse on Viktor as he moves around, poking him in lane.

tips.text: Aim Shocking Orb at Yasuo from long range; the longer it flies, the longer he is stunned. Fire it when he dashes toward you or walks up to last-hit.
Once Yasuo is stunned by Shocking Orb, drop Eye of Destruction on him. He can't leave the center, so it hits hard and slows him.
Don't fire Shocking Orb into Yasuo's Wind Wall, it blocks the orb. Arcanopulse is not blocked, so use it while the wall is up.
Stay far from Yasuo and poke him with Arcanopulse. Charge it for range, and cast it while he walks toward or away from you.
Don't stand still charging Arcanopulse when Yasuo is close, because you are slowed while charging and he can dash onto you.
Use Rite of the Arcane to finish Yasuo when he is low or stuck after a stun. The shots land after a delay, so aim where he is going.
Hold Shocking Orb until Yone walks up to you. A long-range orb stuns him longer, so fire it from far away.
Once Yone is stunned, land the center of Eye of Destruction on him. It hits hard and slows him so he can't close the gap.
Yone's Mortal Steel has short range, so stay far back and poke him with Arcanopulse. Don't let him get close.
Save Shocking Orb when Yone has two stacks on Mortal Steel. His next one dashes at you and knocks you up.
Eye of Destruction slows Yone, which makes Arcanopulse easier to land. Cast it first, then fire the beam.
Yone's Soul Unbound lets him run at you fast and then snap back. Aim Shocking Orb at his spirit form, not at his body.
Stay behind your minions to blunt Yone's Fate Sealed. Don't stand in a line with other enemies at level 6, because he blinks behind the last champion it hits.

comboRefs.note: Eye of Destruction's slow makes Arcanopulse easier to land on Yone as he walks and dashes in lane.

tips.text: Hold Shocking Orb for when Zed jumps on you; a stun from it stops him before his combo, and a longer-range hit stuns for longer.
Poke Zed from far away with Arcanopulse, and charge it for extra range so he cannot reach you easily.
Use Eye of Destruction on Zed when he closes in; it leaves him slowed and easier to hit with Arcanopulse.
Zed is at his weakest right after he uses Living Shadow, so look to hit him then.
Move away from where you stood when Zed marks you with Death Mark; he returns to hit you in a few seconds, so do not stand still.

comboRefs.note: Eye of Destruction's slow helps land Arcanopulse on Zed, who walks around lane and pokes with shurikens.

tips.text: Use Shocking Orb from long range on Bard; the longer it travels, the longer the stun. Follow up right away with Eye of Destruction.
Stay out of a straight line with Bard and his lane partner. Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a second enemy or a wall.
Do not stand next to a wall while Bard can fire Cosmic Binding at you, because hitting terrain also stuns.
Walk over Bard's shrines to destroy them before his ally can take the heal.
Do not hold Arcanopulse charged while Bard is in range. You are slowed while charging and he can bind you.
Watch for Bard's Magical Journey. He and his ally can appear from the side to catch you, so keep your distance.
Stay away from Bard's Tempered Fate area. It freezes everything inside, so your Rite of the Arcane shots may be wasted.
Aim Shocking Orb at Braum from a distance; a long flight makes the stun last longer. Don't throw it when Unbreakable is raised toward you.
Wait for Unbreakable to drop, then throw your spells. Braum's shield blocks missiles, so baiting it out makes your next orb safe.
Stay out of Braum's reach. Winter's Bite and basic attacks start his stun, so don't let him land the first mark.
Use Eye of Destruction on Braum when he walks up, then charge Arcanopulse; the slowed target is easier to hit.
When Braum starts Glacial Fissure, step aside during its long cast time, and don't stand on the ice it leaves behind.
Stay far from Karma and hit her with Arcanopulse while she walks up; she wants to get close.
Aim Shocking Orb at Karma from long range for a longer stun, so she cannot reach you.
Step away from Focused Resolve's tether before it ends; being rooted next to Karma is dangerous.
Move out of the flame circle that Mantra leaves with Inner Flame; it slows you and then bursts.
Use Eye of Destruction on Karma when she steps up; the slow makes Arcanopulse easier to land.
Keep Shocking Orb for when Leona walks at you. Stunned, she cannot start her combo, and the longer it flew, the longer the stun.
Stay far back from Leona. Her Zenith Blade dashes her onto you from a long way off, so keep minions between you.
Do not hold the charge of Arcanopulse while Leona is near; you move slowly while charging. Fire it early or wait.
When Leona uses Eclipse, step away for a few seconds. Its blast only hurts if you are close.
Use Eye of Destruction on Leona as she closes in to slow her. Aim at the center for the strongest slow.
Leave the center of Solar Flare quickly. Only those in the middle get stunned, so move out when it lands.
Aim Shocking Orb from long range when you can; the farther it travels, the longer Lulu is stunned.
Keep Shocking Orb for when Lulu is about to cast Whimsy or walks up. Once she is stunned, follow with Eye of Destruction in the center.
Stay behind your minions and outside her Glitterlance range, then poke her with Arcanopulse from far away.
Stay out of Lulu's reach. If she Polymorphs you, you cannot attack, so don't stand next to her while you charge Arcanopulse.
Aim Shocking Orb from long range for a longer stun, and fire it when Lux steps toward your lane partner.
Charge Arcanopulse behind minions or out of sight; Lux's Light Binding punishes you while you stand slowed.
Stay out of a line with Lux and her Light Binding; it roots the first two enemies it hits.
Use Eye of Destruction to poke Lux when she is trapped by her own cooldowns; put the center on her to slow her hard.
Dodge to the side when Final Spark's red warning beam shows.
Aim Shocking Orb at Milio from far away; the longer it flies, the longer he is stunned, and it hits the first enemy in its path.
After Shocking Orb stuns Milio, land Eye of Destruction on him, since he cannot step out of the center.
Stay outside the range of Ultra Mega Fire Kick, and do not charge Arcanopulse in its path, since you are slowed while charging.
Look for Milio when he is alone and poke him, because he has less mobility without allies nearby.
Wait for Breath of Life to be used before you go all in on a fight; it removes most stuns from his team.
Land Shocking Orb from long range for a longer stun, then follow with Eye of Destruction on the center for a guaranteed hit.
Stay out of Aqua Prison range and step in only when it is on cooldown. Once Nami misses it, you can poke freely.
Aqua Prison lands after a delay, so keep moving while you charge Arcanopulse. Walking straight at or away from Nami makes your beam easier to land.
Aim Shocking Orb at Nami before her ally. The orb stops at the first enemy it hits, so keep other targets out of its path.
When Tidecaller's Blessing is on the enemy carry, back off. Poke them again once it has been used up or has run out.
Sidestep Tidal Wave when you see it coming. It travels slowly, so you have time to walk out of its path.
Stay far back and keep your distance; Nautilus has to reach you to do anything, so poke him with Arcanopulse from long range.
Aim Shocking Orb at Nautilus when he walks up. Fire it from far away so the stun lasts longer, then back off.
Keep Shocking Orb ready for when Nautilus closes in. It is a stun that can stop his approach.
Use Eye of Destruction on Nautilus when he closes in; it slows him and helps you walk away.
Do not stand in a line with a wall or minion behind you when Nautilus is near; his Dredge Line can pull him to terrain, so keep your spacing wide.
Keep Shocking Orb for when Pantheon jumps in; stunning him from a distance gives a long stun and lets your team punish him.
Hit Pantheon with Eye of Destruction as he closes in; the slow gives you time to line up Arcanopulse.
Do not fire spells at Pantheon while he braces with Aegis Assault facing you; he takes no damage from the front. Wait it out or step to the side.
Stay healthy; Comet Spear deals much more damage to low health targets and Shield Vault stuns you.
Do not begin Rite of the Arcane when Pantheon is near; Grand Starfall can reach you from far away, and you cannot move.

comboRefs.note: Eye of Destruction slows Pantheon, making the long Arcanopulse beam easier to land on him.

tips.text: Hit Pyke with Shocking Orb from far away; the longer it flies, the longer he is stunned. Then follow up with Eye of Destruction.
Keep Shocking Orb ready for when Pyke dashes or hooks in. It is your best answer to him closing the gap.
Stay behind your minions and allies. Bone Skewer stops at the first enemy it hits, so a unit in front of you can block the hook.
Do not stand still while charging Arcanopulse when Pyke is close. You are slowed and cannot attack, and he can hook you.
Do not chase Pyke after he is hurt and out of sight. Gift of the Drowned Ones heals him back while he is hidden.
Move away from low-health allies when Pyke is nearby. Death From Below can execute them, and you may be next.
Land Shocking Orb from long range for a longer stun, then follow with the center of Eye of Destruction.
Stay out of Senna's reach. Her attacks have long range, and Last Embrace roots you if it sticks, so don't stand in a straight line with her.
Use Eye of Destruction on Senna when she walks up to attack. It slows her, which makes Arcanopulse easier to land.
Watch for Senna turning into mist with Curse of the Black Mist. She can't be selected while in it, so hold your spells until she shows up again.
Shocking Orb keeps flying after it hits, but it stuns only the first enemy. Aim it so Senna is that first target, not a minion.
Land Shocking Orb from long range for the longest stun, then follow with the center of Eye of Destruction.
Stay out of the line of Beat Drop. If you are already slowed by her, it roots you, so don't walk into her range.
Don't charge Arcanopulse while she is in range. You are slowed while charging and can't dodge Beat Drop.
Shocking Orb is blocked by the first enemy it hits, so aim it down a lane free of minions.
Her Encore charm can start a deadly engage. Stay far back at level 6 and watch for her cast.
Hit Sona with Shocking Orb from long range. The farther it travels, the longer the stun, and she is fragile.
Use Arcanopulse from max range when Sona walks up to poke you. She must come close to use Hymn of Valor.
Land Eye of Destruction on Sona when she moves in. The slow lets you follow with Arcanopulse.
Stay away from your own allies' line when Sona is near, and avoid walking into Crescendo's range. Its stun leaves you open to her team.
Stay behind your minions and keep your distance from Thresh. Death Sentence stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in front of you absorbs it.
Aim Shocking Orb at Thresh from far away for a long stun, then land Eye of Destruction on the center while he can't move.
When Thresh starts his Death Sentence cast, step sideways. The cast is slow, so you can see it coming.
Hold Shocking Orb for when Thresh or his partner dashes in. Flay and Death Sentence both need him close, so stun him first.
Poke Thresh with Arcanopulse when he walks up to collect souls or to hit minions. He is exposed then.
Don't use Rite of the Arcane while Thresh is close. The Box slows you hard and Death Sentence can pull you out of your channel.

comboRefs.note: Thresh has no listed dash or escape, so the slow makes the long Arcanopulse beam easy to land on him.
